title: app command returns no_device — several devices attached or simulator not booted
symptom: app shot · tap · type end with no_device. The response lists android · ios_booted devices
cause: No --device and no $DEV, and the number of attached devices is not exactly one (with several, it stops rather than capture the wrong device). Or the UDID given with --device is not a booted simulator (the list shows only Booted)
fix: Pick one from android · ios_booted in the response and call again with --device <serial or UDID>
Bind a role to pin it as $DEV in env.sh: launch_cli.py device bind --role <role> --serial <serial>
If the list is empty, boot first: emulator -avd <AVD name> or xcrun simctl boot <UDID>
